value.note: PMs orchestrate and compose; they only code solo when no fan-out is needed. Prime is product owner and has final say.

Coders work one unit each per the impl-guide; isolation shape (own worktree vs pm's branch) is set per-plan in the impl-guide. Sol FAST, 1.05M-context variant (Jordan confirmed 1M over the 400K -fast base). Do NOT append :high to the selector — effort rides --effort (pij maps to OMP --thinking high and adds --auto-approve). Until pij#306, pij may print a spurious 'unknown model' warning for this selector; spawn continues. Verification (ermine, live-corrected 2026-08-28): footer proves the MODEL SELECTOR only; spawn argv proves effort was REQUESTED (--thinking high); runtime effort is a DISCLOSED PROOF GAP — OMP renders no active-effort surface (pij#306 may close it).
